title: Your Highlight Reel Isn't Fooling the God Who Sees You Alone
caption:
Somewhere between the church version, the gym version, and the group chat version, you lost track of which one's actually you.

God isn't scrolling your feed. He's watching the room with no camera in it, and that's the only version He's actually building.

Stop editing the private one down. Start building it up until it doesn't need cutting.

#faith #integrity #christianmen #identity #manofgod
